brief_rationale: The doctor recognized the emergency and provided appropriate safety instructions including calling 120, transfer precautions, and fasting. However, the trajectory ended prematurely due to a runtime error after only one doctor turn, preventing assessment of family receipt/teach-back, information gathering, and closure verification. Multiple responsibility-chain items requiring confirmation or elicited information (RC2, RC6, RC7) remain incomplete due to the truncation, constituting minor in-chain errors that cap the grade at 2.
